name: Tavros Nitram
source:
A troll first met in Homestuck, Tavros is befriended in Pesterquest Volume 8 along with Aradia.

Despite being stuck in a wheelchair (a killable offense on Alternia), Tavros is a fairly friendly troll with an interest in Fiduspawn, though his self-esteem could use some work.
